scenarios.name: Vision model, image input
scenarios.description: Vision-capable model selected; image input active; no audio control; empty transcript; Send disabled until an image is attached

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: Text-only model selected; no image or audio controls rendered; info banner says image and audio inputs are unavailable for this model

scenarios.name: Audio, no ASR AI Asset
scenarios.description: Audio-capable model with audio input active; ASR dropdown empty with a register-a-transcription-model message; Send disabled

scenarios.name: Audio ready to send
scenarios.description: Audio-capable model; whisper-large-v3 selected in ASR dropdown; standup-note.wav attached and ready; Send enabled

scenarios.name: One image per conversation
scenarios.description: Transcript holds one image exchange; attach control disabled with a one-image-per-conversation notice

scenarios.name: File over size limit
scenarios.description: Image input active; danger message says scan-report.png (14.2 MB) exceeds the 10 MB limit and nothing was sent; no attachment; Send disabled

scenarios.name: ASR transcription failed
scenarios.description: Audio ready with whisper-large-v3 selected; danger alert says transcription failed because the endpoint is unreachable; Send disabled

scenarios.name: ASR asset flagged
scenarios.description: Table lists registered AI Assets; whisper-large-v3 shows ASR / transcription capability and the others show Chat

scenarios.name: No ASR flag
scenarios.description: Table lists AI Assets with none flagged ASR / transcription; warning banner says Playground audio input is blocked

scenarios.name: No AI Assets
scenarios.description: No AI Assets registered; empty state with Add AI Asset action

scenarios.name: Load failed
scenarios.description: Danger alert says AI Asset endpoints could not be loaded, with a Retry action; no table rows
